summary: Wallowa County lookout whose cab was moved to Buckhorn in 1952; the cab still stands at Buckhorn Overlook and the original tower site is gone.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone; its cab was moved to Buckhorn in 1952 and stood there, crumbling, at a 2023 visit

staffing.status: J.R. Stubblefield listed as lookout personnel

access.note: The cab at Buckhorn Overlook is a tourist stop reached from Enterprise on Highway 82 and then several named and numbered roads; no source gives access to the original Fairchild Point site

events.note: Register gives 1942, with a 1942 photo caption; firelookout.com says the tower dates from the 1930s. The sources disagree
Firelookout.com lists J.R. Stubblefield as known lookout personnel in 1936
Cab lowered from the Fairchild tower and moved to Buckhorn; Rex, the NHLR and firelookout.com all give 1952

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict left open: the register says 1942 (with a 1942 photo caption) and firelookout.com says the 1930s, with a 1936 name. The 1952 cab move agrees across Rex, the NHLR and firelookout.com. Today's condition rests on one 2023 visit report (Cheryl Hill) and was not checked against a Forest Service source. The site has three names (Buckhorn Point, Buckhorn Mountain, Buckhorn Overlook); the identification with the cab rests on Cheryl Hill's statement that the Fairchild cabin was moved there. The 1954 history is cited only through Rex's page, which quotes it; it was not read directly. The register's 2010 site photo is captioned but not described, so it does not establish what remains. Record elevation of 1631.0 m matches the register.
